title: Streams over data loaded from the database

objectives.text: Load rows from a JDBC ResultSet into a list of records, then process that list with a stream pipeline of filter, map, sorted and collect
Distinguish lazy intermediate operations from terminal operations, and predict the error when a stream is reused after its terminal operation
Decide which filtering and aggregation belongs in the SQL query and which belongs in the stream after the rows are loaded
